content.short: Web3MQ provides essential Layer3 Infra with trustless, end-to-end encrypted messaging and distributed storage.
content.description: Web3MQ reconnects isolated social platforms with a unified inbox, enabling information to be freely generated, flowed and communicated across terminals. It supports end-to-end encrypted communication with distributed storage, ensuring that no third party can access users' chat messages and that users have full ownership of their data. Web2 communication is siloed by design, and Web3MQ aims to end this. Open source and simple to integrate, its ecosystem is continuously growing, and it is described as the fastest social layer1 and trustless messaging network.
content.meta: Web3MQ provides essential Layer3 Infra and a trustless messaging network. Discover Web3MQ and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
